description: This PHP class 'LDAPSyncStatusDecorator' is a decorator for the LDAPSyncStatus entity, providing methods to access and format synchronization timestamps and to reference the user who performed the sync. It utilizes traits for common functionalities and encapsulates logic for handling LDAP sync status details within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LDAPSyncStatus entity, providing methods to retrieve formatted LDAP synchronization timestamps and set the associated user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LDAPSyncStatusDecorator with an LDAPSyncStatus entity.

methods.name: setSyncedUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the LDAPSyncStatus based on a given user ID.

methods.name: getSyncStartedDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of LDAP sync in formatted string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSyncStartedTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of LDAP sync in formatted string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedDate
methods.description: Returns the finish date of LDAP sync in formatted string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedTime
methods.description: Returns the finish time of LDAP sync in formatted string, or null if not set.
